note: City of Omaha flood-control lake run by the Lake Cunningham Development Trust. Two concrete-pad RV campgrounds on one entrance road (8305 Rainwood Rd), either side of a narrow arm of the lake: West C (electric only) and East C (full hookup, with the C Store concession open Fridays and Saturdays). The waterside pads are at the south end of West C. No storm shelter: watch the weather. --Claude
summary: Operator pages confirm everything stored and add dated 2026 rates (West C $37/$42, East C $47/$52 + tax, 3% online fee), RoverPass booking up to 1 pm day-of, no walk-ups, 2-night weekend / 3-night holiday minimums, 14-night max, 2026 season April 17-November 1, 83 sites with sizes. Base $37 passes the $50 gate. Lakefront kept (a handful of West C pads end 15-20 m from a cove across open grass). Pin on West C; East C ~270 m east on the same road, not a split.
flags: WATERFRONT lakefront holds: at West C's south end (~41.3434,-96.0455) several back-in pads branch off the loop road toward a cove of the lake and end 15-20 m from the water across open mown grass, with the road behind them (NAIP 0.33 m/px; the West C map draws the water along that edge). Elsewhere: West C's east side and East C's west row face the narrow lake arm across 25-60 m of wooded bank or the loop road (view at best). East C's map shows only creek lines.
PIN OK: stored 41.34487,-96.04475 is on West C's entry road by its restroom. East C's spine is ~270 m east (~41.3440,-96.0415).
SPLIT: no. East C and West C share one entrance road and sit ~300 m apart either side of the lake arm, under one booking system.
